svg.title: Both are identities under (25). Every block therefore has positive diagonal and zero determinant: it is positive of rank one. Covariance transfers this to every branch, proving complete positivity and the stated Choi ranks. Trace preservation follows on the basis Suv from ∑︁ j Tuj = 1. With initial state I/3, direct application gives Φj(I/3) = Dj/3, Φk(Dj) = Sjk/3, ∑︂ j Dj = I.
